title: One coordinate step of the coordinate-path Poincaré estimate on Q_δ (parent step 3)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, v : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ of class C¹, 0 ≤ δ < 1/2, k ∈ Fin (m + 1), Q_δ := {y : δ < y_i < 1 − δ for all i}. For x, y let a_k(x, y) have coordinates y_j (j < k), x_j (j ≥ k) and b_k(x, y) have coordinates y_j (j ≤ k), x_j (j > k), and let e_k := EuclideanSpace.single k 1. Then ∫_{Q_δ} ∫_{Q_δ} |v(a_k(x, y)) − v(b_k(x, y))| dy dx ≤ (1 − 2δ)·volume(Q_δ)·∫_{Q_δ} |Dv(x)e_k| dx.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (v : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (δ : ℝ) (k : Fin (m + 1)), ContDiff ℝ 1 v → 0 ≤ δ → δ < 1 / 2 → ∫ x in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, |v (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => if j < k then y j else x j)) - v (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => if j ≤ k then y j else x j))| ≤ (1 - 2 * δ) * (volume {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}).toReal * ∫ x in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, |fderiv ℝ v x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)|
